ideas.pitch: A localized multi-language emergency triage assistant designed specifically for Baltimore community health clinics to reduce wait times and assess non-urgent walk-ins.
ideas.title: Hopkins-Med-Triage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly taps into the regional healthcare focus seen in past wins like mediscan-ai and SAGACITY, which appeal strongly to local medical and academic judging panels.

ideas.pitch: A rapid 60-second voice biomarker analysis tool tailored for local neurology outpatient screening in Maryland.
ideas.title: CharmCity-Voice-Parkinsons
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact winning formula of Timbre by packaging complex audio-based health diagnostics into a fast, highly demonstrable 60-second live demo.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered clinical interview and physical exam simulator using computer vision pose tracking to grade medical students on patient empathy and CPR technique.
ideas.title: MedStudent-OSCE-Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven grand-prize-winning architecture of Clinical-Simulator, which judges love because it showcases complex computer vision working live in a browser.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent AI framework that reviews health insurance prior authorization denials for demographic and socioeconomic bias before submission.
ideas.title: InsureCheck-Bias-Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopted directly from the claim-bias-evaluator winning strategy, targeting high-value administrative pain points in healthcare systems using multi-agent verification.

ideas.pitch: An AI nutrition and meal planning assistant customized for local Maryland food desert constraints, optimizing cheap, accessible grocery items for specific health profiles.
ideas.title: CharmCity-NutriFit-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines the proven first-prize mechanics of E-Foodiee with a hyper-local social impact angle that resonates well with community-minded hackathon judges.
